# `aitbc auth status`

Show the stored authentication credentials for an environment.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc auth status [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--environment` | text | `default` | no | Credential environment name |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc auth status
```
